children.game_version: Play sand-stepping game where dancers simulate moving through deep sand while pumping arms.

seniors.counts: Count 1-2 up-and-down arm pumps per measure.
seniors.seated_version: Perform alternating vertical arm pumps with flat palms while seated upright in a chair.
seniors.standing_version: Maintain slight knee flex while holding onto a stable support and alternating arm pumps.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Perform at moderate tempo with comfortable vertical arm range.

learning_units.description: Stationary stance with slightly bent knees and head alignment.
Alternating vertical up-and-down arm motion with flat palms.

social_formats.description: Solo dance executed in social dance party settings.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Arms held almost straight with palms flat and aligned, moving alternately up and down vertically.
movement_profile.footwork: One or two small rhythmic steps forward and backward, or standing stationary simulating feet in sand.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Solo dancer staying largely in place or moving within a small personal space.
movement_profile.hips_and_torso: Upper torso remains aligned with the head while arms pump vertically.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Low to medium level ground movement with slightly bent knees; no jumps described.
movement_profile.posture: Almost stationary with knees slightly bent, head aligned with the upper torso.

signature_moves.description: Alternating vertical up-and-down motion of nearly straight arms with flat palms.
signature_moves.name: Vertical Arm Pump

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Excessive waist bending or losing flat palm alignment.

music_profile.sound_description: Upbeat early 1960s pop and R&B driven by vocal harmonies, rhythmic handclaps, or Latin jazz charanga percussion patterns.
music_profile.vocal_style: 1960s pop and R&B vocal quartet style, Latin jazz spoken/percussive vocal calls

basic_steps: Stand with knees slightly flexed and head aligned with upper torso.
Hold arms nearly straight with palms flat and aligned.
Alternate moving arms up and down in a vertical motion.
Optionally step forward and backward one or two small rhythmic steps.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly craze dance focused on arm isolation and micro-stepping.
teaching.rhythm: 4/4 meter pop and R&B rhythmic pulse
